letter: I'm looking to join a development team as a junior full stack or web developer. I work with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Django, and my projects have given me practical experience connecting interfaces, APIs and data.

In Fracxion, I built company-level permissions and internal invoicing and payment workflows backed by PostgreSQL. I implemented transactions and row-level locking, and worked on tests for permissions and concurrent operations. For Ragnar Suplementos, a commissioned store currently at the demonstration stage, I built the storefront, catalog admin panel and inventory logic.

I'd like to contribute to web development tasks, learn from the team and improve through code review. I use Claude Code and Codex as development tools, taking responsibility for reviewing, debugging and validating changes.
My portfolio and GitHub include code and technical decisions. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss a role and walk through my work.
shortLetter: I'm a Junior Full Stack Developer based in Argentina, looking to join a team working with React, Next.js or Django.

My projects include Fracxion, a multi-tenant business application with company-level permissions and transactional payment workflows, and Ragnar Suplementos, a commissioned store currently in demonstration. My contributions include interfaces, APIs, inventory logic and tests.

I'd like to contribute to web development tasks and grow through feedback and code review. My portfolio and GitHub provide code and explanations of the decisions behind these projects. I'm available to discuss a role and explain my work.
